title: 4056. Number of Intersecting Interval Pairs I

examples.explanation: There are 2 intersecting interval pairs: Intervals [1, 2] and [2, 3] intersect at the point 2. Intervals [2, 3] and [3, 4] intersect at the point 3.
There are 3 intersecting interval pairs: The intersection of [1, 5] and [2, 4] is [2, 4]. The intersection of [1, 5] and [3, 6] is [3, 5]. The intersection of [2, 4] and [3, 6] is [3, 4].
There are no intersecting interval pairs. Hence, the answer is 0.
